details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> models : fix GDN normalization from `max` to `rsqrt` (#28068) * models: use flash-linear-attention's l2norm for gated delta net q/k The GDN q/k normalization is defined by flash-linear-attention as l2norm(x) = x * rsqrt(sum(x*x) + eps) with eps inside the root. Every GDN call site in the tree uses ggml_l2_norm instead, which is x / max(sqrt(sum(x*x)), eps), i.e. torch.nn.functional.normalize - its CUDA kernel cites that page.
